snippet.title: SeverLink Game Announcement Teaser Trailer (2026)
snippet.description:
SeverLink (previously Project KVASIR) is a third-person stealth-action game. Designed as a love letter to classic infiltration titles, it offers diverse levels, dynamic AI, player freedom, and thematic depth.

Wishlist us: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3285390/Severlink/

Set in 201X, after a world-altering Y2K bug stalled technological progress, the game embraces a retro-futuristic aesthetic shaped by early-2000s hardware and culture.

Coming to steam in 2028
